chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: حَمْدَوَيْه، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُوسَى، عَنِ دَاوُدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashshi: Hamduwayh, from al-Hasan ibn Musa, from Dawud ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad who said:

chunks.arabic_text: وَقَفَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ فِي بَنِي زُرَيْقٍ فَقَالَ لِي وَهُوَ رَافِعٌ صَوْتَهُ: يَا أَحْمَدُ قُلْتُ: لَبَّيْكَ قَالَ: إِنَّهُ لَمَّا قَبَضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ جَهَدَ النَّاسُ فِي إِطْفَاءِ نُورِ اللَّهِ فَأَبَى اللَّهُ إِلَّا أَنْ يُتِمَّ نُورَهُ بِأَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ فَلَمَّا تَوَفَّى أَبُو الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ جَهَدَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي حَمَّزَةَ وَأَصْحَابُهُ فِي إِطْفَاءِ نُورِ اللَّهِ فَأَبَى اللَّهُ إِلَّا أَنْ يُتِمَّ نُورَهُ وَإِنَّ أَهْلَ الْحَقِّ إِذَا دَخَلَ فِيهِمْ دَاخِلٌ سَرُوا بِهِ وَإِذَا خَرَجَ مِنْهُمْ خَارِجٌ لَمْ يَجْزَعُوا عَلَيْهِ وَذَلِكَ أَنَّهُمْ عَلَى يَقِينٍ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ وَإِنَّ أَهْلَ الْبَاطِلِ إِذَا دَخَلَ فِيهِمْ دَاخِلٌ سَرُوا بِهِ وَإِذَا خَرَجَ مِنْهُمْ خَارِجٌ جَزِعُوا عَلَيْهِ وَذَلِكَ أَنَّهُمْ عَلَى شَكٍّ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ جَلَّ جَلَالُهُ يَقُولُ: فَمُسْتَقَرٌّ وَمُسْتَوْدَعٌ

translations.en: Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) stood at Bani Zurayq and said to me while raising his voice: 'O Ahmad.' I said: 'At your service.' He said: 'When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) passed away, the people strove to extinguish the light of Allah, but Allah refused anything but to perfect His light through the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him). So when Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) passed away, Ali ibn Abi Hamza and his companions strove to extinguish the light of Allah, but Allah refused anything but to perfect His light. And indeed, when a person joins the people of truth, they are delighted by him, and when he leaves them, they do not grieve for him, because they are certain of their affair. And when a person joins the people of falsehood, they are delighted by him, and when he leaves them, they grieve for him, because they are in doubt about their affair. Indeed, Allah, Majestic is His Majesty, says: “an enduring abode and a place of temporary lodging.”'

chunks.arabic_text: ثُمَّ قَالَ: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: الْمُسْتَقَرُّ الثَّابِتُ وَالْمُسْتَوْدَعُ الْمَعَارُ

translations.en: Then he said: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: The enduring abode (al-mustaqarr) is the established [constant faith], and the temporary lodging (al-mustawda') is the rented out [faith which will not last].

en.summary: This narration from Al-Kashi highlights the continuity of divine guidance through the Imams, specifically noting the efforts of Ali ibn Abi Hamza and his companions to preserve the 'light of God' after the death of Imam al-Rida. It establishes a theological criterion for distinguishing the faithful from the hypocritical by contrasting their emotional responses to new entrants and departures, rooted in certainty versus doubt. The Imam further elucidates the Quranic terms 'al-mustaqarr' (the permanent) and 'al-mustawda'' (the deposited) as metaphors for enduring and temporary faith, respectively.
en.seo_question: What is the difference between the people of truth and the people of falsehood regarding their certainty and reaction to change?
